name: pis-sandbox
description: Project-scoped, rootless Podman wrapper for the Pi coding agent

scripts.test:rpc-compat: node --input-type=module -e "if (!process.env.PIS_PI_PACKAGE) { console.error('Set PIS_PI_PACKAGE to an installed candidate Pi package directory.'); process.exit(1); }" && node --test test/pi-rpc-compatibility.test.js
scripts.test:pi-compat: node --input-type=module -e "if (!process.env.PIS_PI_PACKAGE) { console.error('Set PIS_PI_PACKAGE to an installed candidate Pi package directory.'); process.exit(1); }" && node --test test/pi-compatibility.test.js test/updates.test.js
